subject: Medly MAP: hosting & region tradeoffs + action items
messages:
From: Elena Morris <emorris@medly.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medly.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & hosting preference: Medly evaluation plan

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the run-through last week. The product and performance looked promising. We need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) from Redwood that lays out milestones, what success looks like for our evaluation, and a suggested close timeline. A few constraints to highlight up front:

- Data residency: our legal team prefers EU data handling for any PII; US hosting is acceptable for a PoC if we can guarantee isolation and contractual safeguards.
- Compliance: we need SOC 2 evidence, basic KMS integration details, and an audit log cadence for the evaluation phase.
- Timeline: product team wants to be production-ready (internal sign-off) by 2026-07-15. Procurement/finance will need an early view on pricing delta between hosted, dedicated, and private.

Can you send a MAP draft that includes an evaluation plan (PoC -> canary -> production), suggested hosting path (hosted -> dedicated -> private) with recommended gating criteria, and a timeline we can take to stakeholders? I attached our internal questionnaire so you can see what level of detail procurement will need.

Appreciate it — Elena

[Attachment: Medly_MAP_questions.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@medly.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & hosting preference: Medly evaluation plan

Elena —

Thanks, this is exactly what we need to get the MAP aligned. I pulled together an initial draft (attached) with proposed milestones, a risk-based gating approach, and cost-ballpark ranges per hosting mode. High-level summary:

- PoC (2 weeks): Hosted API (US) — fastest to start; limited dataset, synthetic PII redaction. Goal: validate integration surface, latency, and basic quality metrics.
- Extended eval (3–4 weeks): Hosted with EU routing + KV cache isolation — collect telemetry and deterministic evals. If EU residency is required for the eval dataset, we can spin up EU-dedicated pods for the extended eval.
- Pre-prod canary (2 weeks): Dedicated capacity in the chosen region — deterministic performance and SLA emulation.
- Prod (target 2026-07-15): Private deployment only if required by legal/finance after procurement review.

Gating recommendations (short):
- Quality gate: model eval pass rate >= 92% on Medly test prompts
- Latency gate: p95 <= 350ms for common query size
- Cost gate: projected per-token cost delta within procurement tolerance (we list estimated ranges)

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Karthik, can you produce a two-column cost delta (hosted vs dedicated vs private) for the three phases by EOD Wed?
2) Laura, please pull SOC 2 excerpts and KMS/HSM integration notes to attach to the MAP draft.
3) Priyom, I'll need the MAP timeline in HubSpot (I pasted a Drive link below) and a short mutual action checklist we can run with procurement.

I've attached MAP_v1_Medly.pdf. If this direction works, I'll schedule a technical deep-dive later this week to cover data residency options and network controls.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: MAP_v1_Medly.pdf (pdf)]

From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@medly.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morris <emorris@medly.com>, procurement@medly.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & hosting preference: Medly evaluation plan

Vanessa/Team —

Quick clarifying notes from legal/procurement:

- If the evaluation will touch production PII, we need EU data residency for that traffic.
- Procurement wants an initial commercial rubric: one-time onboarding, monthly committed capacity (for dedicated), and uplift for private deployments (list as % uplift).
- Timeline: engineering has a hard date request for production readiness: 2026-07-15. If that requires private deployment, we need a firm cutover plan and support SLAs.

Can you add procurement_terms.pdf (attached) to the MAP and include an expected approval lead time from Redwood for dedicated/private (legal + onboarding)?

Thanks,
Carlos

[Attachment: procurement_terms.pdf (pdf)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Medly MAP — action owners and near-term asks (do not forward)

Team —

Recap of external asks and what I want us to own this week:

- Karthik: cost delta by hosting mode (break out onboarding, monthly base, per-token). Include an expedited path to provision EU-dedicated pods (time to provision, minimal commit).
- Laura: pull SOC 2 report excerpts and a one-page KMS integration note + key management flow we can hand to legal. Also include our recommended audit log retention options for private vs dedicated.
- Priyom: create the HubSpot MAP record and a mutual-action checklist (Milestone IDs + owners + target dates). Add the Drive link and HubSpot deal id.

Suggested tight timeline to align with Medly's 2026-07-15 target:
- 5/18: MAP draft sent (done)
- 5/20: Commercials & SOC2 + cost delta in MAP
- 5/21–5/28: Technical deep-dive + eval dataset run (PoC)
- 6/11–6/25: Dedicated canary (if chosen)
- 7/01–7/14: Cutover window

Notes on routing: propose an interim architecture — hosted US for PoC with EU-edge routing and strict KV cache partitioning. If legal signs off on residency constraints, we can fast-track EU-dedicated pods before the extended eval.

Flagging risk: private deployment lead time (on-prem or VPC) is currently ~8–10 weeks for onboarding + contractual review; call this out to procurement as the critical path if they insist on private for go-live.

Vanessa

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <emorris@medly.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@medly.com>
